user_query: I want to gather direct download URLs and titles of popular songs from various music genres on YouTube in both MP3 and MP4 formats for my school project.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of popular music genres.
For each genre, search for popular songs on YouTube.
Retrieve the titles and URLs of the identified popular songs and ensure they are available in MP3 and MP4 formats for download.
Organize the collected data into a structured format for analysis.
